text: Follow-up in 4e7f732 and 3a5b0a6 (17 November 2026): the described data types now follow the BIDS schema file rules (bids-specification f9d3b8a) and are tested against 3,869 file paths from 39 public example datasets. Importing 23 example datasets end to end exposed and fixed three problems: sidecar numbers are recorded exactly; an unreadable participants.tsv is a finding, not a failed import; stimulus files may have any name. Fourteen of the 23 are accepted outright; eight fail only on empty placeholder MRI images.
